name: Mini Browser
description: Small in-app web browser — URL bar, back/forward/reload/home, an iframe, and a server-side proxy that strips X-Frame-Options/CSP so sites that would otherwise refuse to be framed can still be viewed inside AW. Also pilots the shared aw-app-browser container over CDP (navigate/click/type/eval/screenshot), ported from aw-app-devctl: a mini-browser-browser MCP tool wrapper is contributed for agents via mcp.json, with an HTTP twin under /browser/* for fetching screenshot bytes back onto the workspace filesystem.

home_url.description: URL the browser loads on open and on the home button.
